answer: A plume of per-task receipts records who did what, and the umber of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ember of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
